Phase 2P records this historical-PnL evidence-projection gap as the fourth post-consolidation Lane A typed mirror evidence-collection artifact: a deterministic four-scenario typed historical-PnL evidence pack (BTCUSDT realized-long winner x3, ETHUSDT realized-short winner x3, LABUSDT realized-short loser x3 [LAB hedge-unwind / squeeze legacy-failure pointer], SOLUSDT orchestrator-held blocked x3) and a pure-function harness driving the existing PaperModeRuntime and PaperExecutionLedgerRecorder composition roots end-to-end.
